The P/E ratio of 36.3 is significantly higher than the sector benchmark of 35.95x [E6], suggesting RTL may be overvalued in comparison to its peers. However, RTL's Price-to-Book (P/B) ratio of 2.52x [E2] is well below the sector benchmark of 2.59x, indicating that RTL might be undervalued relative to its book value. Despite this, RTL’s ROA and ROE are significantly lower than their respective sector benchmarks [E8] and [E9], suggesting poor operational efficiency and profitability. The median return on equity over the last five years is 21% [E13], which is higher than RTL's current ROE of 6.94%, implying that RTL may be undervalued in terms of its long-term earning potential. Therefore, while RTL faces challenges with its financial metrics and valuation compared to its peers, the evidence suggests it could still be underappreciated by the market.
